content.text:
**Finding: missing — no post-termination transition assistance or data return.**

Investigation covered all four substantive sections: Section 4 (Term; Termination; Termination Payment) addresses only notice, the Termination Date and the Termination Payment mechanics; Section 1.5's "export files" obligation is an in-term order/inventory interface, not an exit export; Section 8 (Confidentiality) imposes no return-or-destroy duty; and Section 10.7 (Survival) preserves only Sections 6.3, 7, 9 and 10. HDI hosts the Site and holds our Content, user information and customer/order data with no obligation to hand it back — this fails even the fallback (90 days' assistance plus 30-day export).

Cure: a single inserted Section 4.3 after p0029, at the preferred position — up to six months' transition assistance at HDI's then-current rates, return of Company Data within 30 days in a commonly used machine-readable format, and certified deletion thereafter. The redline validated with `ok:true` and passed the minimality gate; all six preferred elements are carried by the one operation, with the 90-day/30-day fallback flagged in the comment.
